subject: design-technology
title: Ergonomics & Anthropometrics
welcome_lead: Designing things that fit human bodies.
meta_desc: KS3 D&T: ergonomics, anthropometrics, human-friendly design.
final_note: Good design fits the human using it.

concepts.def: Designing things to fit people well.
How a measurement compares to others.

walkthroughs.body_html: Ergonomics is making things fit how people use them. A chair, a door handle, a phone — all need to suit the human shape and movement.
Anthropometrics = body measurements. Designers use data tables of heights, hand sizes, grip strengths. Aim for 5th to 95th percentile — fitting most people.
Inclusive design includes people with disabilities, elderly users and children. Big buttons, clear contrast, easy grip — these help everyone, not just the few.
